SELECT r.* FROM gkzh_zytj_record r
ORDER BY r.record_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finished, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' AND r.is_timeout = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS timeoutCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' AND r.type_code IS NOT NULL AND r.type_code <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS typed, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN r.duration_ms END), 0), 0) AS avgDurationMs FROM gkzh_zytj_record r

SELECT r.type_code AS typeCode, MAX(r.feature) AS feature, MAX(r.career_field) AS careerField, MAX(r.typical_careers) AS typicalCareers, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM gkzh_zytj_record r
AND r.status = 'finished' AND r.type_code IS NOT NULL AND r.type_code <> '' GROUP BY r.type_code ORDER BY selectedCount DESC, typeCode

SELECT 'EI' AS dimensionCode, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', 1)) AS letter, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM gkzh_zytj_record r
AND r.status = 'finished' AND r.item_codes IS NOT NULL AND r.item_codes <> '' GROUP BY TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', 1)) UNION ALL SELECT 'SN' AS dimensionCode, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', 2), ',', -1)) AS letter, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM gkzh_zytj_record r
AND r.status = 'finished' AND r.item_codes IS NOT NULL AND r.item_codes <> '' GROUP BY TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', 2), ',', -1)) UNION ALL SELECT 'TF' AS dimensionCode, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', 3), ',', -1)) AS letter, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM gkzh_zytj_record r
AND r.status = 'finished' AND r.item_codes IS NOT NULL AND r.item_codes <> '' GROUP BY TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', 3), ',', -1)) UNION ALL SELECT 'JP' AS dimensionCode, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', -1)) AS letter, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM gkzh_zytj_record r
AND r.status = 'finished' AND r.item_codes IS NOT NULL AND r.item_codes <> '' GROUP BY TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', -1))

SELECT COALESCE(p.title, '未填写院系') AS departmentName, COUNT(*) AS participantCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finishedCount FROM gkzh_zytj_record r LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department d ON d.department_id = r.department_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department p ON p.department_id = d.parent_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(p.title, '未填写院系') ORDER BY participantCount DESC, departmentName

SELECT COALESCE(p.title, '未填写院系') AS departmentName, 'EI' AS dimensionCode, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', 1)) AS letter, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM gkzh_zytj_record r LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department d ON d.department_id = r.department_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department p ON p.department_id = d.parent_id
AND r.status = 'finished' AND r.item_codes IS NOT NULL AND r.item_codes <> '' GROUP BY COALESCE(p.title, '未填写院系'), TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', 1)) UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(p.title, '未填写院系') AS departmentName, 'SN' AS dimensionCode, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', 2), ',', -1)) AS letter, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM gkzh_zytj_record r LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department d ON d.department_id = r.department_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department p ON p.department_id = d.parent_id
AND r.status = 'finished' AND r.item_codes IS NOT NULL AND r.item_codes <> '' GROUP BY COALESCE(p.title, '未填写院系'), TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', 2), ',', -1)) UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(p.title, '未填写院系') AS departmentName, 'TF' AS dimensionCode, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', 3), ',', -1)) AS letter, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM gkzh_zytj_record r LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department d ON d.department_id = r.department_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department p ON p.department_id = d.parent_id
AND r.status = 'finished' AND r.item_codes IS NOT NULL AND r.item_codes <> '' GROUP BY COALESCE(p.title, '未填写院系'), TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', 3), ',', -1)) UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(p.title, '未填写院系') AS departmentName, 'JP' AS dimensionCode, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', -1)) AS letter, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM gkzh_zytj_record r LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department d ON d.department_id = r.department_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department p ON p.department_id = d.parent_id
AND r.status = 'finished' AND r.item_codes IS NOT NULL AND r.item_codes <> '' GROUP BY COALESCE(p.title, '未填写院系'), TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.item_codes, ',', -1))
SELECT * FROM gkzh_zytj_record WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND game_type = 'zytj' ORDER BY record_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
